overview: Medford Public Schools officials conducted a random lottery to assign fifth-grade students from the district's four elementary schools to the Andrews and McGlynn middle schools. Assignments were generated using a random number generator and results were scheduled for immediate online publication.

items.title: Lottery Procedures and Open House Dates
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent and Dr. Ricciardelli explained that students would be assigned via a digital random number generator, with two draws per school to ensure balanced enrollment. The district announced middle school open houses for May 2 and May 4, with official assignment letters to follow.

items.title: Brooks Elementary School Lottery
items.summary: Completed two lottery draws for students attending Brooks Elementary School.

items.title: McGlynn Elementary School Lottery
items.summary: Completed two lottery draws for students attending McGlynn Elementary School.

items.title: Missituk Elementary School Lottery
items.summary: Completed two lottery draws for students attending Missituk Elementary School.

items.title: Roberts Elementary School Lottery
items.summary: Completed two lottery draws for students attending Roberts Elementary School.

items.title: Assignment Notification and Closing
items.summary: The administration confirmed that lottery results would be posted by student ID number on the district website within 30 minutes of the meeting's conclusion.
